sentences.text: The accused Nos.1 & 2 in C.C.No.353/2022 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-III, Perumabavoor, have filed this petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, to quash the proceedings against them in the said case.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-III, Perumabavoor
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The allegation against them is that they, along with the third accused, verbally abused and criminally intimidated the de facto complainant, who is the daughter-in-law of the petitioners, and thereby committed the offences punishable under Sections 294(b) & 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (in short, 'IPC').
2.
In the present petition, the petitioners would contend that they are totally innocent and that they have been falsely implicated in this case.
It is further stated that none of the offences alleged against them are attracted in the facts and circumstances of this case.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor representing the State of Kerala.
4.
Originally, the final report in this crime was filed by the investigating agency with twin charges.

The offence under Section 498A IPC was alleged separately against the petitioners herein, in 2025:KER:58951 addition to the offence under Sections 294(b) & 506 IPC alleged against the Abraham M.V vs The State Of Kerala on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59381446/
2 petitioners and the third accused.

entities.text: Abraham M.V vs The State Of Kerala
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In respect of the offence under Section 498A IPC, the petitioners were earlier proceeded against in C.C.No.288/2021.
However, the aforesaid case was quashed by this Court as per order dated 29.11.2022 in Crl.M.C.No.8272/2022.

It is thereafter that a separate prosecution was launched in C.C.No.353/2022 against the petitioners and the third accused in connection with the offences under Sections 294(b) & 506 IPC.
5.

A reading of the First Information Statement given by the de facto complainant/third respondent would reveal that the whole allegations pertaining to verbal abuse and criminal intimidation are directed against the third accused, and not the petitioners herein.

Except for a stray remark at the concluding portion of the First Information Statement that the third accused verbally abused and criminally intimidated her with the connivance of the petitioners herein, there is absolutely nothing on record to show that the petitioners were having any role in the commission of the aforesaid offences.

A casual and superficial allegation in the above regard about the connivance of the petitioners in the commission of the offence by the third accused, is 2025:KER:58951 not sufficient to proceed against the petitioners for the commission of the aforesaid offences.
Needless to say that the prosecution records do not contain anything to fasten the petitioners with criminal liability of the offences under Sections 294(b) & 506 IPC.
That being so, the proceedings against them, are liable to be quashed.

In the result, the petition stands allowed. The proceedings against the petitioners (accused Nos.1&
2) C.C.No.353/2022 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-III, Perumabavoor,
which arose out of Crime No.718/2021 of Kuruppampady Police Station, are hereby quashed.
